title: something, anything, nothing, someone, anywhere…
en:
some- (something, someone/somebody, somewhere) — positive sentences and offers: I need something to drink. Would you like something?

any- — questions and negatives: Is there anything wrong? I didn't see anyone.

no- (nothing, no one/nobody, nowhere) — negative meaning with a positive verb: I saw nobody. (= I didn't see anybody.)

every- — all: Everyone is here. Everything is ready. These words take a singular verb.
ru: some- — в утверждениях и предложениях (Would you like something?), any- — в вопросах и с not, no- — отрицание с утвердительным глаголом (I saw nobody, не I didn't see nobody). Everyone/everything — глагол в ед. числе (is).

boss.situation: Write a short audit note: what you checked and what you found. Use something / anything / nothing / someone / no one / everything.
samples: I checked everything in the warehouse.
Someone left the door open at night.
We didn't find anything wrong with the stock count.
Nobody signed the visitors' log on Saturday.
Nothing is missing, but something must change.

qs.q: I'm hungry. I want ___ to eat.
Is there ___ in the meeting room?
I didn't say ___.
___ called you this morning — a man from the bank.
I looked everywhere but found ___.
___ is ready for the meeting. We can start.
Would you like ___ to drink?
We didn't go ___ at the weekend.
“Everybody are happy” is correct.
“I didn't see anybody” and “I saw nobody” mean the same.
Did ___ call while I was out?
There's ___ in the fridge. It's empty.
I need ___ to help me with this report.
Let's go ___ quiet to talk.
___ knows the answer. Even the manager doesn't know.
Is there ___ I can do to help?
Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: i did not find anything wrong

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: someone has left the door open

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: is there anything else you need

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: everything is ready for the audit

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: we have nowhere to keep the old files

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I didn't see nobody.”
Correct the mistake: “Everybody are here.”
Correct the mistake: “I don't have nothing to say.”
a: I don't have anything to say.
I do not have anything to say.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “Nothing didn't happen.”
Correct the mistake: “I want to go anywhere hot this summer.”
a: I want to go somewhere hot this summer.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “Somebody don't know the password.”
a: Somebody does not know the password.

qs.q: Кто-то оставил дверь открытой.
a: Someone has left the door open.
Somebody has left the door open.

qs.q: Я ничего не нашёл.
Всё готово.
Никто не ответил.
Ты что-нибудь слышал?
Хотите что-нибудь выпить?
a: Would you like something to drink?
Do you want something to drink?

qs.q: Мы никуда не ходили в выходные.
a: We didn't go anywhere at the weekend.
We did not go anywhere at the weekend.
We went nowhere at the weekend.
We didn't go anywhere on the weekend.
We did not go anywhere on the weekend.

qs.q: Все на совещании.
